subject: BYOK rotation: staging rekey window and ops handoff
messages:
From: Timothy Lowe <tim.lowe@acme-systems.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYOK rotation in staging + evidence request

Hi Sofia,

We need to rotate the customer-managed keys in our staging environment next week as part of our pre-production cutover. Security asked for a short plan and audit evidence we can attach to the migration ticket (SOC2 and internal compliance).

Constraints:
- Window: prefer 2026-09-10 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic)
- Keys in scope: prod-like KEK and wrapping keys used by the inference VPC (2 key aliases)
- We cannot have more than 30s median latency impact for token requests; any longer requires rollback
- Operator contacts will be from Acme: erika.lane@acme-systems.com (ops), sec-ops@acme-systems.com

Questions:
1) Can Redwood provide an ops play-by-play we can include in the ticket
2) Will you sign off on a 15-minute smoke test post-rotate for evidence?
3) Any additional artifacts you can provide for our audit (cmd outputs, runbook, logs)?

Thanks,
Tim
Timothy Lowe
Head of Platform Security, Acme Systems
Attachment: acme_byo_rotation_plan_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Lowe <tim.lowe@acme-systems.com>
Cc: acme-security@acme-systems.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK rotation in staging + evidence request

Hi Tim — thanks for the heads up. We can support the 2026-09-10 02:00-04:00 UTC window; scheduling confirmed on our side pending final sign-off from infra.

High-level ops play-by-play we propose (we'll produce a formatted runbook PDF and the post-run artifacts):
- T-90: preflight checklist (inventory keys, snapshot config, collect baseline latencies)
- T-30: freeze non-essential deploys in staging, notify SRE pager
- T-10: operator lock (prevent new key writes)
- T0: rotate KEK alias -> create new key, perform wrap/unwrap test against sample corpus
- T+5: staggered rolling rewrap of wrapped secrets for inference nodes (continuous KV caching maintained)
- T+15: automated smoke tests (latency p95/p99, token generation correctness)
- T+30: rollback window until T+60 if regressions are observed; finalize artifacts and sign-off at T+90

Artifacts we will provide: runbook export (staging-rekey-runbook.docx), operator CLI logs for wrap/unwrap, per-route latency snapshots (token-level), and a signed handoff note. We can also provide a minimal script output for inclusion in your audit.

Can you confirm operator contact details and whether we should include docuSign approval for the rotation? If so, please share the primary signer.

I'll loop in our ops lead for the handoff.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
Attachment: staging-rekey-runbook.docx (docx, 450KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: BYOK rotation in staging + evidence request

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Acme's request. Key points and proposed internal assignments below. Please confirm and I'll pass the finalized runbook back to Tim.

On Thu, Sep 3, 2026 at 09:12 Timothy Lowe <tim.lowe@acme-systems.com> wrote:
> We need to rotate the customer-managed keys in our staging environment next week as part of our pre-production cutover...

Action items (proposed):
- Marissa: lead on-runbook and tie into our runbook generator; produce the "artifacts bundle" (runbook PDF, smoke test outputs, logs).
- Ben: prepare the rotation orchestration script and the wrap/unwrap validation harness; ensure KV cache warming strategy to avoid p95 spikes.
- Sofia (me): coordinate cutover window with Acme, run final checklist, and own rollback decision.

Operational notes:
- Rewrap strategy: perform rewrap incrementally by inference shard; each shard should drain KV cache for 5s and warm from cache before serving traffic.
- Telemetry: enable per-key histogramming and brief increased sampling (1m) for the T-30 to T+60 window.
- Audit evidence: collect signed runbook, CLI outputs from key create/wrap calls, and a short signed note confirming smoke test metrics.

Risks:
- Latency spike if rewraps are done in parallel across shards — mitigation: staggered job and backpressure token limiter.
- Operator mis-authorization — mitigation: 2-person approval on key import + ephemeral operator creds for the window.

Please attach any preflight check scripts to this thread when done.

— Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

2) Share the operator SSH/SSO contacts so we can provision ephemeral operator creds (we will revoke after T+90).

Marissa Cole
